subject.title: [Feature]: Option to skip tool list text in system prompt (reduce duplication)

question: Should OpenClaw add a scoped opt-in config surface for suppressing the human-readable Tooling list while keeping callable schemas, or should this remain covered by existing Tool Search, localModelLean, and tool allow/deny controls?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config surfaces and the tradeoff affects prompt behavior across providers and models.

options.title: Add Narrow Opt-In
options.body: Add a scoped agent/default option that suppresses only the Tooling list text, with docs, context reporting, and tests proving customTools remain available.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Tracker
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/14785 the owner for this subtask and keep this issue only as linked evidence until that tracker lands a plan.

options.title: Decline New Knob
options.body: Keep current behavior and direct users to Tool Search, localModelLean, tools.allow, and tools.deny for prompt-size control.

recommendation.title: Add Narrow Opt-In
recommendation.body: Add a scoped agent/default option that suppresses only the Tooling list text, with docs, context reporting, and tests proving customTools remain available.

likelyOwner.reason: History and current discussion both route the prompt/tool-search decision to this area owner candidate.
